title: Da Buddha / SSV Mouthpiece
description:
Upgrade your vaping experience with the Da Buddha / SSV Mouthpiece, a high-quality replacement part designed for Da Buddha Vaporizer (DBV) and Silver Surfer Vaporizer (SSV). Crafted by 7th Floor Elev8, this mouthpiece ensures smooth airflow and optimal performance. Available in multiple vibrant colours, it perfectly complements your vaporizer’s style. Keep your Da Buddha parts fresh and enjoy uninterrupted sessions with this durable, easy-to-clean accessory.

Whether you’re replacing a worn-out piece or customizing your setup, the Da Buddha Vaporizer mouthpiece offers a seamless fit and elevated experience. Order now and enhance your vape game!
